reach_check.question: In Hollow Knight, how do I get past the big armoured knight guarding the way on in the first proper area?
reach_check.why_this_one: Hollow Knight was added today. The boss is never named - it is described - so this tests whether the search finds the right note from a plain description rather than matching a word.
reply_named: jump the shockwave he throws when he slams his mace
hitting the armour gives little soul, so save Focus until the armour empties
once it is bare, hit the head
back off before he starts raining barrels down
reach_check.verdict: PASS. Every one of those is from the False Knight note. A game added today, reached from a description, with no game running.

findings.what: The panel still names a game that has been closed
findings.detail: After exiting Hades, the line under the question box still read 'Context: active game AppID 1145360'. The Hollow Knight question still worked, because naming the game in the question resolves it - but a question asked without naming a game could pick up the wrong game's notes.
findings.severity: worth filing; not proven to cause a wrong answer yet
